name: FruitConnect
summary:
FruitConnect turns your Meta Quest into a wireless Mac display with audio. See your Mac desktop as a floating 2D panel in Quest Home and hear it through your headset — no need to take off your Quest.

HOW IT WORKS
Install the Mac and Quest apps and pair once with a 6-digit code or QR scan. FruitConnect connects automatically:
- Same Wi-Fi or USB-tethered — direct peer-to-peer, works fully offline
- Anywhere with internet — encrypted Remote Access
Screen and audio stream via WebRTC with hardware H.265 video
